rows.text: computes the element count (qword `[rcx+8]` minus qword `[rcx]`) / 0x18 and, when `edx` is above it (unsigned), calls `0020BB10(rcx, qword [rcx+8], edx - count, pointer to a zeroed 0x18-byte stack value)` and returns its result; otherwise adds to qword `[rcx+8]` the signed 0x18-byte-element distance that moves it to qword `[rcx]` + `edx` * 0x18, and returns that byte delta in `rax`
